lower('HELLO')	hello
upper('hello')	HELLO
initcap('hello world')	Hello World
length('hello')	5
char_length('héllo')	5
octet_length('héllo')	6
bit_length('abc')	24
substr('abcdef', 2, 3)	bcd
substring('abcdef', 4)	def
left('abcdef', 2)	ab
right('abcdef', 2)	ef
replace('banana', 'na', 'X')	baXX
translate('12345', '135', 'abc')	a2b4c
repeat('xy', 3)	xyxyxy
split_part('a,b,c', ',', 2)	b
lpad('hi', 5, 'xy')	xyxhi
rpad('hi', 5, 'xy')	hixyx
reverse('héllo')	olléh
ascii('A')	65
chr(65)	A
md5('abc')	900150983cd24fb0d6963f7d28e17f72
quote_ident('select')	"select"
quote_literal('a''b')	'a''b'
concat('a', NULL::text, 'b')	ab
concat_ws('-', 'a', NULL::text, 'b')	a-b
format('%s:%I:%L', 'v', 'user', 'x')	v:"user":'x'
strpos('abc', 'bc')	2
starts_with('abcdef', 'abc')	true
'a' || 'b'	ab
'2'::int4 + 3	5
1 + '2'	3
